def execute_command(image) -> List[ImagePatch]:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    cars = image_patch.find("red car")
    if not cars: return image_patch
    
    # Find the center of the image
    center_x = image.shape[1] / 2
    center_y = image.shape[0] / 2
    
    # Sort cars based on their distance from the center
    cars.sort(key=lambda car: abs(car.horizontal_center - center_x) + abs(car.vertical_center - center_y))
    
    # Filter out cars that are too far from the center
    near_cars = [car for car in cars if abs(car.horizontal_center - center_x) < 0.2 * image.shape[1]]
    
    return near_cars
